cues: Photosystem one can also work alone.
The electron from ferredoxin turns back to plastoquinone and returns to P700 through the cytochrome complex.
Protons are still pumped, so ATP is made, but no NADPH and no oxygen, because water is never split.
text: Photosystem one can also work alone. The electron from ferredoxin turns back to plastoquinone and returns to P700 through the cytochrome complex. Protons are still pumped, so ATP is made, but no NADPH and no oxygen, because water is never split. That is cyclic photophosphorylation.
